notes.accuracy: LLM-judge correctness (qwen3.7-plus judge, top_10 cutoff); categories 1-4 only — category 5 (adversarial) was not run
notes.scored_f1: normalized token F1 (lowercase, punctuation and articles stripped) of hypothesis vs golden answer, computed post-hoc
notes.lexical: hypothesis-vs-golden-answer metrics using the same formulas as the ref files (whitespace tokens for f1/bleu/meteor, rouge_score for rouge, NLTK bleu with method1 smoothing)
notes.latency_ms: per-question memory search latency (Mem0 cloud v3 search, top_k=10); answer-generation time not included
notes.context_tokens: tiktoken cl100k_base token count of retrieved_memories (the top_10 context shown to the answerer)
